name: presentations-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-presentations — owns the top-bar "Presentation" nav entry (core.nav) AND every open presentation's floating window body (core.window.body:presentations.viewer, one instance per presentation id via the 2026-08-05 dynamic-window framework addition). src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
